title: flow:wave: nobody owns worktree teardown, so every merged branch leaves its worktree behind
assessment: Housekeeping failure with measured accumulation; one upstream fix plus downstream adoption, not an emergency.

title: Chart a wayfinder map: CxPP's resilience as a derived repo, and the drift gate nothing proves is running
assessment: Research seed, not an established outage. Earlier schedule acceptance materially narrows the premise.

title: Evergreen: revalidate Codex harness, cross-session messaging, and watcher assumptions
assessment: Intentionally evergreen monitoring; exclude from unresolved defect counts.

title: Proposed changes: harden native wave delivery, listening, and worker recovery
assessment: Integration/recovery program with existing owners; avoid refiling each remaining criterion.

title: nit store: claude-code-review is native so no CPP edit reaches it, and the generated flow skills need a refresh pull to inherit one
assessment: Useful review-routing adoption; batch with the planned downstream refresh.

title: Nit Store
assessment: Nit Store inbox; never count it as an unremediated software defect.

title: Prove reliable handoffs and agent freedom with integration coverage and delivery pilots
assessment: Planned live acceptance work; justified before claiming the integrated feature works.

title: Account for delivered outcomes and agreed revisions in PR completion evidence
assessment: Planned completion-accounting improvement; prefer existing PR evidence over more infrastructure.

title: Let agents challenge requirements and revise implementation plans within agreed intent
assessment: Planned delegation-policy improvement; judge its benefit through a real delivery pilot.

title: Preserve governing outcomes and acceptance context across implementation handoffs
assessment: Real source/context handoff gaps; producer repair merged, live acceptance explicitly remains open.

title: Validate and harden existing spec-sync identity and parser compatibility
assessment: Confirmed identity/parser/dependency failures; scoped repair delivered in PR #234.

title: Separate intended outcomes, constraints, and revisable approaches in lightweight issue contracts
assessment: Proportional issue contract; useful process change, not newly introduced product risk.

title: [Balanced delivery] Wave 3: Verify outcomes and demonstrate implementation freedom
assessment: Wave parent containing two implementation issues; exclude from defect totals.

title: [Balanced delivery] Wave 2: Preserve context and enable evidence-based plan revision
assessment: Wave parent containing two implementation issues; exclude from defect totals.

title: [Balanced delivery] Wave 1: Establish lightweight intent and reliable task identity
assessment: Completed wave parent; closing it adds no independent shipped outcome.

title: Demonstrate local Kylex delivery with native Codex waves and reproducible evidence
assessment: Demonstration requires settled target/scope; wrong-repository parent links need reconciliation before assignment.

title: Report latest CPP adoption drift in a separate scheduled and manual workflow
assessment: Planned upstream reporting; configured-cron acceptance is recorded in its closing comment.

title: Implement native session wake and delivery adapters from the bounded transport proof
assessment: Native delivery acceptance remains unfinished; current implementation honestly withholds native dispatch.

title: Implement durable native wave events, acknowledgements, and replay-safe transitions
assessment: Planned durable-event capability; recovery follow-up was completed using the existing issue.

title: Repair the CPP PIN and verify immutable source reproduction without changing payloads
assessment: Invalid source PIN impaired provenance; concrete reproducibility repair, not optional polish.

title: /flow:repair resolves the installer through the artifact it repairs, so a stale installer reports FLOW_HELPERS: ok and fixes nothing
assessment: Repair resolves a stale installed installer and cannot deliver new helpers; operationally meaningful.

title: The fail-soft blind spot cost a red pipeline, and its only mitigation is one hand-written decorator nothing protects
assessment: A real CI regression plus a known scanner blind spot; first diagnosis was amended. Group under the existing control family.

title: Gates ship blind: give every instrument an executable negative control, and prove the control can fail
assessment: Cross-cutting control proposal. Prove a small pilot before expanding registration machinery to every gate.

title: pygments 2.19.2 and pytest 9.0.2 carry OSV advisories in the root uv.lock and are tracked by no issue
assessment: Dev-package advisories need reachability/trust-boundary assessment; no automatic emergency or mandatory upgrade.

title: Preflight serveability has no freshness window, and serveability itself was observed to expire within minutes
assessment: A preflight cannot guarantee future service. Time stamp/failure handling useful; another blocking freshness gate is not yet justified.

title: Possible fix(deps): urllib3 2.6.3 → 2.7.0 (CVE-2026-44432) in uv.lock
assessment: Dependency report justified assessment; scoped upgrade merged. Advisory severity alone does not establish local exposure.

title: Possible fix(deps): 14 vulnerable dependencies in uv.lock
assessment: Scanner count/remedy corrected; headline vulnerable component reported unused. Assess remaining dependencies independently.

title: worktree-remove: the #905 unpushed-commits check reads every squash-merged branch as unpushed once gh-pr-merge.sh deletes its remote ref
assessment: Safety fix rejects ordinary squash-merged cleanup. Predicate independently reproduced here; failure is conservative, not data loss.

title: flow-finish-gate: the #769 retry reports "the failure reproduces" from the invocation exit code, not from whether the retried id reproduced
assessment: Retry verdict misattributes a failure while retaining a failed result. Useful diagnostic correction; batch the sibling verdict cases.

title: Model-presence preflight greps a prefix, so it passes on the wrong model - shadowed by #903's serveability probe, not fixed
assessment: Prefix match is wrong, but the stronger exact-model serveability probe already catches it; consider deleting the redundant check.

title: check-test-binary-guards: a test that runs a repo script DIRECTLY bypasses the one-hop scan - 11 of 12 curl tests were invisible
assessment: Scanner missed common executable-script calls and CI failed. Bounded correction delivered.

title: flow-wave-mailbox ps lane: ps truncates argv, so a live watcher reads as a confident 0 in a long checkout path
assessment: Fallback watcher detection can falsely refuse a healthy worker in a long path; conditional but concrete.

title: flow-finish-gate: the #769 re-run cannot tell a flake from an order-dependent failure, calls it a flake, and marks the step SUCCESS
assessment: Runner explanation overclaimed a flake; PR #912 confirms the outer gate already warned. Do not repeat the original clean-pass allegation.

title: DATA LOSS: worktree-remove deletes uncommitted work on an idle worktree with --force, and never checks unpushed commits at all
assessment: Uncommitted/unpushed work deletion is a material data-loss hazard. Fix was necessary; downstream installation still matters.

title: flow-wave-mailbox.sh:263 asserts the harness CANNOT re-invoke an agent on a background completion; it can, and the socket is live in a container
assessment: Stale absolute harness claim in a code comment; correct/batch it, without treating it as authorization to adopt another transport.

title: qwen:auto and gemma:auto preflight check registration, not serveability - both clear the gate against a host that SIGKILLs the model loader
assessment: Registered model could not serve. Legitimate preflight correction; runtime failure still needs its own honest outcome.

title: delegated-run-check: a codex `item.type: "error"` is invisible, so a lane whose execution tool never started reports success
assessment: Nested execution-tool error reports success by default. Independently reproduced; --expect-tools fails but loses the specific diagnosis.

title: flow-wave-registry: a non-resolving --repo silently disables claim reconciliation, and the result depends on the reader's cwd (#800 covered only the empty case)
assessment: Invalid/relative repository identity disables reconciliation; extends an earlier empty-input-only fix.

title: security_scan is missing from GATE_STEP_IDS, so a skipped security gate reports ok instead of warn
assessment: Skipped security scan omitted from warning membership; meaningful evidence defect, not proof of an actual leak.

title: flow: a live-owned worktree can report CLAIM=free, and worktree-remove --force then deletes it (#597 gap)
assessment: Live ownership missing from the claim path permitted unsafe forced cleanup; same loss family as #899.

title: pre-push(#959): mypy failing under KYLE_DEPLOYED=1 still reports a plugin construction error, because django-stubs swallows the settings exception
assessment: After #1119 the hook already identifies an environment failure. Remaining variable-specific diagnosis is lower priority.

title: fleet(#861): every container's helper surface is frozen at spawn - 8 dead inodes and 2 absent entries, measured with a two-sided control
assessment: Reported stale mounts retain pre-fix destructive helpers. High conditional impact; repository merge alone does not remediate running copies.

title: deploy: the acceptance gate picks its checks from an unreconciled declaration - dev runs a remote_tmux session whose check the gate does not request
assessment: Acceptance chooses checks from unreconciled capabilities; a deployed placement can escape verification.

title: deploy: session.host_boot is structurally host-tmux bound, so the promotion gate still needs a local_tmux subject - and it needs removing, not widening
assessment: Second promotion dependency survives #1193; treat as completion of the placement transition.

title: deploy: the promotion gate hard-requires local_tmux - the placement #782 retires, so promotions become unsatisfiable
assessment: Retired-placement requirement blocks promotion. First scripted portion fixed; linked residual remains.

title: test: five lifecycle-cutover tests read live fleet state, so they pass in CI and fail on any host with a Kyle master running
assessment: Explicitly withdrawn: wrong KYLE_ENV invocation caused the failures. No code change needed.

title: deploy: the targeted lane does not install ~/.claude/skills, so host sessions have run four-day-stale boot and mailbox skills
assessment: Targeted deploy omitted the former skill-install path; reported four-day stale instructions are a migration defect.

title: memory: the consolidation gate cannot see a group run that finishes normally - only one that is aborted
assessment: Transcript hook misses server-side normal completion; real boundary-coverage gap in the consolidation design.

title: Member cap counts disabled members, so a group at the cap with dead workers cannot be added to or recovered
assessment: Disabled members consume cap while historical members cannot be deleted; prevents group recovery.

title: Group edit: the member Delete checkbox cannot work for any member that has ever launched, and reports the raw ProtectedError
assessment: Delete UI conflicts with protected launch history. Resolve with #1181 as one member-retirement outcome.

title: proxvmqwen45: llama-server SIGKILLed ~18s into every weight load - the /qwen:* lane is dead
assessment: Reported model-serving outage was real; later records describe owner intervention/unavailability. Reconfirm disposition before new repair work.

title: Health check page is blind to the qwen/gemma model hosts - and must probe serveability, not reachability
assessment: Owner-requested dependency visibility; useful operations work. Avoid costly inference on every health-page poll.

title: fleet: the single-file-mount cadence rule in CLAUDE.md rests on a falsified input - Claude Code's own Edit/Write tools rename, so "by hand" does not mean "in place"
assessment: Single-file mount policy relied on incorrect assumptions about editor writes; reconcile the installation lifecycle with #1197.

title: fleet: CLAUDE.md is not mounted into session containers, so the owner's global directives never reach the default placement
assessment: Default container placement omitted owner instructions. PR #1189 delivers a copy; verify remaining live adoption before closure.

title: security: three budget-* identity manifests declare tiers contradicting migration 0026 - budget-worker (archetype worker) holds tier 3 (admin), re-applied on every deploy
assessment: Worker admin tier was an actual privilege overgrant. Source repair merged September 14; deployed row repair was not checked here.

title: session image: codex is mounted without codex-code-mode-host, so /codex:auto is inert in every container and `codex doctor` reports 18 ok / 0 fail
assessment: Required execution binary missing in reported container image; useful installed-path smoke test would catch it.

title: memory: Kyle writes every memory to Claude Code's file store instead of memory_write - 0 DB writes in 72h while the subsystem reports healthy reads
assessment: Operational memory-write path unused despite working tools. Important product outcome gap; invocation alone will not prove useful learning.

title: test(#1143): the short-sentinel-vs-checkout-path defect is a class of six, and two are still live
assessment: Short sentinel collides with ordinary generated worktree names; repair as a test family instead of filing each occurrence.

title: memory(#1062): rank-on-truncate leaves 85% of a worker's briefing budget unused - greedy first-fit stops at the first oversized row
assessment: New ranking interacts with existing stop-at-first-large-row packing; confirmed code mechanism, reported worker briefing degradation.

title: test(#1143): nothing pins the MCP-token substring assertion's necessity, so a simplifier would delete it
assessment: Future deletion of a useful test assertion is hypothetical. Targeted negative control can help, but a standalone issue was not risk-urgent.
